parse.title: Falador Diary
parse.wikitext:
==Easy==
{| class="wikitable lighttable qc-active diary-table" style=width:750px; data-diary-name="Falador" data-diary-tier="Easy"
! style="width:50%;" | Task
! style="width:50%;" | Requirements
|-
|1. Find out what your family crest is from [[Sir Renitee]]
''Note: You must finish the dialogue.''
|
*{{SCP|Construction|16|link=yes}}
|-
|2. Climb over the western [[Falador]] wall.
|
*{{SCP|Agility|5|link=yes}}
|-
|3. Browse [[Sarah's Farming shop.|Sarah's farm shop]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|4. Get a Haircut or a Shave from the [[Hairdresser|Falador Hairdresser]].
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|5. Fill a [[bucket]] from the [[Waterpump (Falador)|pump]] north of [[Falador west bank]].
|
*[[Bucket]]
|-
|6. Kill a [[duck]] in [[Falador Park]].
|
*None, though using [[Magic]] or a [[Ranged#Weapons|Ranged weapon]] is recommended
|-
|7. Make a [[mind tiara]].
|
*[[Tiara]] and a [[mind talisman]]
|-
|8. Take the [[Monk_of_Entrana|boat]] to [[Entrana]].
|
*Have no [[weapons]] or [[armour]] equipped or in your inventory
|-
|9. Repair a [[broken strut]] in the [[Motherlode Mine]].
|
*[[Hammer]] and any [[pickaxe]]
|-
|10. Claim a [[security book]] from the [[Security guard]] at [[Port Sarim]] jail.
''Note: The guard is found upstairs. Ask him about security and finish the dialogue.''
|{{NA|None}}
|-
|11. Smith some [[Blurite Limbs]] on [[Doric]]'s anvil.
|
*{{SCP|Quest}} Completion of [[The Knight's Sword]] and [[Doric's Quest]]
*{{SCP|Mining|10|link=yes}} and {{SCP|Smithing|13|link=yes}}
*[[Hammer]] and a [[Blurite bar]]
|}

===Rewards===
*[[Falador shield 1]]:
**Can restore 25% of [[prayer points]] once a day
*[[Antique lamp (easy)|Antique lamp]] worth 2,500 experience in any skill of at least level 30
*Access to the [[Tight-gap (Goblin Village)|tight-gap shortcut]] from [[Burthorpe]] to the [[Chaos Temple (Asgarnia)|Chaos Temple]] (with 14 [[Agility]])
